$comment: Retention decisions for branches whose name matches PROTECTED_PREFIXES in scripts/lib/worktree-lifecycle.mjs (backup/, preserve/, recovered/, stage/). A protected prefix stops automatic deletion but records nothing about WHO preserved the branch or FOR HOW LONG, so protection never expires and the set only grows. An entry here supplies the missing half. It NEVER authorises deletion: every protected branch stays KEEP_PROTECTED whatever this file says, and removing one remains a human action. Run `npm run worktrees` to see which branches still have no entry.

policy.expires: YYYY-MM-DD, or "never" for material that must be kept permanently
policy.onExpiry: The branch is REPORTED as needing review. Nothing is deleted automatically.
policy.guidance: Prefer an annotated tag over an indefinite branch: a tag conveys the same commits, is not a merge target, and does not appear in branch listings agents scan for work.

$comment_ci_prefix_branch_reviews: A SEPARATE feature that happens to share this file (A6, 2026-09-05) — do not confuse the two. `branches` above is keyed by PROTECTED_PREFIXES (backup/preserve/recovered/stage/, an OBJECT, read by scripts/worktree-lifecycle.mjs). This key is for release/ios/android/capacitor branches — the prefixes that gate .circleci/config.yml's `ios`/`android` compile jobs by branch NAME (filters.branches.only) — read by control-plane-verify.mjs's protected-prefix-branch-retention check, which FAILs when such a branch's tip is older than 14 days and has no entry here. It is an ARRAY, not an object, because control-plane-verify.mjs only ever needs 'is this name present', never a keyed lookup. `hotfix/*` does not appear in this key's scope: grepped 2026-09-05 across every .github/workflows/*.yml and .circleci/config.yml, and the only two hits for the literal string were a code comment about a past incident and this sentence — nothing in either CI system actually gates on that prefix, so it is not one of the prefixes this check protects.
